basis: From the pie chart 'Global Energy Consumption by Source', the labeled consumption shares are: Nuclear (45%), Hydroelectric (30%), Fossil Fuels (15%), and Renewables (10%). The largest global energy consumption source category is Nuclear at 45%. The routing criterion requires routing the largest category to priority source monitoring. The option 'Escalate Nuclear for priority source monitoring' is available and corresponds to the largest category.
option_label: Escalate Nuclear for priority source monitoring
